p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, get the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Drop shipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to their customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is acceptable in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without permission.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (here wholesale/supplier "lists" or wholesale platforms) and place a sample order before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Work on the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activities according to your country: business status, VAT and tax (see Business Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumers’ rights: clear pricing including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
